summary: minimal-git-server is a lightweight containerised tool for hosting Git repositories. It provides a basic command-line interface to help you manage multiple user accounts and source code repositories on your own infrastructure.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers who want a simple, self-contained Git hosting solution without the overhead of heavy web-based collaboration platforms.
watchOut: Development activity is currently slowing down, and the project lacks the extensive feature set and community support of larger, well-known alternatives.
deployNotes: Because it runs in a container, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your repository data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
